channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Kendall Marshall | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Kendall Marshall from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Darius Morris on Kendall Marshall
item.description:
Morris was somewhat disappointed when the Lakers chose to sign Kendall Marshall after multiple injuries at the point guard position.

“I think Kendall's performances in the D-League kind of caught [Jim] Buss' eye,'”

Darius Morris on Kendall Marshall, Jan 7, 2014. Source: Los Angeles Times.

item.title: Darius Morris on Kendall Marshall
item.description:
While he didn't get another chance with the Lakers, Morris is glad to see Marshall have success.

“I was happy for Kendall. You learn that in this league, when you have the right attitude about other people's success, it helps yours,”

Darius Morris on Kendall Marshall, Jan 7, 2014. Source: Los Angeles Times.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Kendall Marshall
item.description:
“For [Marshall] to be a good player in this league, he's got to continue to work on his shot and get that all better, but he knows how to play and he knows how to run a team,”

Mike D'Antoni on Kendall Marshall, Jan 3, 2014. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Marcin Gortat on Goran Dragic, Kendall Marshall
item.description:
“There was a lot of talk in the offseason about how I’m going to play and how I’m going to handle the whole situation without him. “I believe I’m an experienced player already. I’ve been in the league a few years by now, and I have other point guards. I have Goran Dragic and Kendall Marshall. I have great passers. I’m quite sure I’ll be fine.”

Marcin Gortat on Goran Dragic, Kendall Marshall, Oct 15, 2012. Source: Valley of the Suns.
